notes.title: V0.2 Playtest - The Fate System Arrives!
notes.content:
[h3]⚔️ [b]What Is the Fate System?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]An [b]auxiliary roguelike layer[/b] that tackles two core goals:
🎯 [b]Deepen decision-making[/b] – more surprises, less repetition
🎯 [b]Expand strategic skill expression[/b] – reward clever plays[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 [b]How It Works[/b][/h3][p]🃏 [b]Fate Cards[/b][/p][list][*][p]New skills activated before combat by [b]spending specific dice[/b] (e.g., one “6”)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Only a portion of cards are available in this test[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎲 [b]Acquiring Fate Cards[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/619f80f56076048962562ed2cb56f38b8706ec0e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Start of each run: [b]Choose 1 of 3 random Fate Cards[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Forge [b]Master[/b] or [b]Divine[/b] relics: Choose 1 of 3[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase non-Apprentice relics: [b]Chance to trigger 3-choice draft[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Roll straights or triples during dice phase: Choose 1 of 3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Max 5 Fate Cards equipped[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎯 [b]Dice & Activation[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/f04ff855c00ff7247d1755221987076cf50ece40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/d51943db8f33940e46a3772bcd62f31b075b63d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/15fb5ee91318d2bcaf4035a9e4c115b9cfdedff8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Dice are [b]resources to activate Fate Cards[/b] (e.g., spend a “4” pip)[/p][/*][*][p]Start with [b]two 6-sided dice[/b]; upgrade to [b]max 5 via shop[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Fate Phase[/b] (pre-combat), roll dice, then [b]drag pips onto cards[/b] to activate them[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚔️ [b]Fate in Combat[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/686bae4fddd50ea52a026122c4ea147693d070dc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Activated cards function like [b]bonus relics for one battle only[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reset each round – adapt to new dice rolls![/p][/*][*][p]In close matches, [b]Fate strategy becomes the tiebreaker[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][p]We’re excited to bring you a fresh experience and look forward to your valuable feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fighting Rogue V0.2 Playtest Begins September 25
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/1dad87e2efb57fced3bdebee6dc9622a940a52e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Save data from the previous playtest will be wiped. The V0.2 update introduces the [b]Fate System[/b], designed as an auxiliary mechanic to address two key goals:[/p][p align="start"]🎯 Make roguelike decisions more engaging and reduce repetition fatigue
🎯 Expand strategic freedom for players to showcase skillful plays[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The system is seamlessly integrated into the shop phase—the core decision-making loop of the game—adding a layer of tactical depth where it matters most.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]During the shop phase, players will encounter [b]Fate Cards[/b] of varying tiers available for activation. These cards provide additional buffs, but activating them requires rolling dice to obtain matching point values.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’ll leave the detailed mechanics for you to discover tomorrow! Ultimately, through this new system, we hope to offer players not only conventional build strategy but also diversified fun combining roguelike elements, meaningful choices, luck-based bonuses, and hands-on manipulation.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We’re excited to bring you a fresh experience and look forward to your valuable feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fighting Rogue Second Wave Playtest Launches Today
notes.content: [p]Greetings, heroes of the jianghu![/p][p][/p][p]Our game is returning for another encounter—the [b]Second Playtest[/b] launches today! [/p][p][/p][p]This time, the playtest will be extended, but the experience will be different. To make testing more refined and balancing more precise, we’ve planned to split the playtest into [b]two phases[/b]. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]📜 Phase One[/b][/h3][p]Phase One begins on [b]September 2nd[/b]. For veterans who joined our first test, it will feel familiar, as it builds upon the[b] Feiyan Manor[/b] and [b]Hanmei Pavilion[/b] sects from last time. The main improvements include:[/p][list][*][p]Reworked several Tier-3 Relics.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Stat balance adjustments for all Relics and sect character skills.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Refined UI and text polish.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Anti-cheat upgrades and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved English localization.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For returning players, some fundamental issues have been addressed; for newcomers, the initial experience will be much easier to get into.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/43de6959e3f9148d0a27aebf7c358d19355a319e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎲 Phase Two[/b][/h3][p]The second phase is scheduled to commence on a chosen date between [b]late September and end of October[/b]. So what’s new this time?[/p][p]Do you remember the wild gameplay ideas we teased during the last test? One of them has been developed and will debut in Phase Two—[/p][p]Introducing: [b]Destiny Dice[/b] 🎲[/p][p]●  We see this as a supporting system designed to solve two key goals:[/p][p]○ 🎯 Make roguelike decision-making more fun and less repetitive across runs.[/p][p]○ 🎯 Add more strategic space for skillful play and creative choices.[/p][p][/p][p]This system isn’t standalone—it’s woven into the [b]Blacksmith[/b] flow, one of the game’s core decision points. When forging higher-tier [b]Artifacts[/b], you may be offered a [b]Destiny Card[/b] to activate. Each Destiny Card provides extra bonuses, but activation requires rolling dice to achieve the necessary results.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/f0053389f18cbe3b3d36d31e6c6aca7aade0d387.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We won’t reveal all the details just yet 😉, but in this playtest, we hope players will enjoy not only the usual strategy of building synergies, but also a fresh layer of [b]risk–luck–decision–skill[/b] dynamics for even more diverse fun.[/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for today’s preview![/p][p]We hope this upcoming playtest will bring a more polished experience along with brand-new ideas to try out. Mark your calendars—see you all on [b]September 2nd[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 【Dev Log】Fate Dice System - New Tactical Depth Incoming!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Why We Chose Fate Dice[/b][/h3][p]After playtesting multiple roguelike prototypes, your feedback crowned [b]Fate Dice[/b] as the winner! This system solves two core issues:
1️⃣ [b]Replayability Boost[/b]: Fresh decisions every run.
2️⃣ [b]Skill Expression[/b]: Your choices directly impact combat success.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Core Mechanics Breakdown[/b][/h3][p][b]Core Fate Cards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/906f6414d45cd85474529b2e02c080240467528e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/fa94edcb25e23d9db1a9758f49901986fcca3da3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Faction-defining ultimates (e.g., Cold Plum's assassination techniques)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Activation[/b]: Consume specific [b]dice pips[/b] (e.g., one 6-pip die)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Impact[/b]: Grants battle-changing skills for [b]one fight only[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Customization[/b]: Choose 1 of 3 cards per faction pre-run[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Support Fate Cards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/3ef46c40a7fb3eaf9c4d7e71a06735dbeab6e31f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Fuel Core Fate activation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mechanic[/b]: Low pip cost (e.g., 1-3 pips) → [b]Refunds rarer pips[/b] (e.g., spend 2, get 6)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Synergy[/b]: Chain reactions enable powerful Core activations[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Dice Economy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/1fc8c59e7b254e9f37162a3fe06068d0a6f9c0b0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Start with [b]two 6-pip dice[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Unlock more via shop upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Allocate dice strategically during the [b]Fate Phase[/b] (pre-combat minigame)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fate Phase: Your Tactical Playground[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/db49cb5ec14c7be5e1f1025e6b897a28db47c9d8.png"][/img][/p][olist][*][p][b]Roll[/b] your dice pool (e.g., rolls: 1,2,3,4,5)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag & allocate[/b] pips to activate Fate Cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chain refunds[/b]: Activate Support Cards first to fuel Core Cards!
[i]Example: Spend "2" on "Qi Flow" (Support) → get "6" → use "6" on "Lethal Strike" (Core)[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Progression & Collection[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/750cbba4da5be441d1a2b063ef5bbdbe6d7ac5e8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]100+ Support Cards[/b] to discover[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge powerful relics[/b] to earn Fate Cards:[/p][list][*][p]Grandmaster relics → [b]3-choice Fate Card packs[/b] (Core/Support)[/p][/*][*][p]Divine relics → [b]Guaranteed elite Fate Cards[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What This Means for Combat[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/24f7dab64fc94aa2106423990e46983720858856.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Activated Fate Cards function like [b]combat relics[/b] with one-battle effects[/p][/*][*][p]Every fight demands [b]new dice strategies[/b]—no autopiloting![/p][/*][*][p]Future PvP balance will hinge on Fate Dice mastery[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V0.1 Playtest: Community Feedback & Dev Response
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey Jianghu Heroes![/b][/h3][p]Thanks for playing [i]Rogue Wulin[/i] and sharing your feedback! We’ve compiled your top questions—let’s dive in:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Can we combo three manuals into one?"[/b][/h3][p]A: [i]Great idea![/i] We’re exploring this as a potential faction mechanic. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Will you add PvE modes like [i]Slay the Spire[/i]? (PvE early, PvP late)"[/b][/h3][p]A: PvE is on our radar, but dev resources are tight. We’re prototyping options![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Any plans for multiplayer?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Likely post-PvE. Debating formats (auto-chess? 3v3?). For now, we’re polishing core gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Faction weapons need more visual distinction."[/b][/h3][p]A: Agreed! Each faction already has [b]12 unique manuals[/b]. We’ll add [b]faction-exclusive relics[/b] soon![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Male characters? That guy in the screenshot?"[/b][/h3][p]A: YES! The fist-fighting dude in our Steam caps? He’s from a new faction—coming soon! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/9949dd34f859b6f558d5f1c5791c14a40465c1a5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Ultimate move animations are too rare!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Update incoming! We’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Show ults [b]every round[/b] (first use)[/p][/*][*][p]Add an [b]animation toggle[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/4e42f08418713123b267df47aa1096bdb45b8035.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Dodge is OP! Buff DoT builds!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Balancing is ongoing. We’re crunching data to tune DoT/sustain![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Ults don’t scale with Inner Power?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Clarification:[/p][list][*][p][b]Outer Power[/b] ≈ [b]Physical DMG[/b] (e.g., Bai Xinyan’s ult)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inner Power[/b] ≈ [b]Magical DMG[/b] (e.g., Su Lianxiang’s ult)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Progression feels grindy! 1% per 30-min run?!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Oops—[i]not our intent![/i] We’re [b]slashing grind[/b] and smoothing unlocks ASAP.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Cheating in async PvP?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Anti-cheat will launches with next playtest version. Fair matches guaranteed![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "When does testing end?"[/b][/h3][p]A: TBD—we’ll announce dates once optimization goals are met. notes.title: Fate System Gameplay New Concept: Dual-Faced Relics!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow heroes![/p][p]After discussing the [i]Fate: Matrix[/i] prototype, your "dual-purpose card" idea (like Tarot reversals) sparked this new concept: [b]Fate: Dual-Faced Relics![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/6a74147aa6675404778286732fb4e49328856e05.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Playtest Description[/b][/h2][p]To emphasize again, this Steam beta version is still a work in progress due to time constraints, so not all features are included. Initially, we planned to have Store, Combat, and Fate segments, but unfortunately, the Fate gameplay didn’t make it into this version. However, don’t worry! The current gameplay flow works fine![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/6d55b7166659b5ac4ca32606f7757523c9b1f385.png"][/img][/p][p]Earlier, we discussed some Fate System gameplay  concept. If you're interested, you can check it out here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3378130/view/528724050310070676"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3378130/view/507331412174575236"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What Are Dual-Faced Relics?[/b][/h3][p]Some relics can [b]mutate[/b], gaining:[/p][list][*][p][b]Front Face[/b]: Original effect[/p][/*][*][p][b]Back Face[/b]: [i]Stronger effect[/i] + [b]Qi Backlash[/b] (a risky downside, akin to "走火入魔" / cultivation corruption)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/8e3f7db892d2720e39e8a7a5b191a853ce1bfe17.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Acquiring Them[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Bound to Armory[/b]: Cannot be sold/stored in inventory—essentially "cursed items."[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/bb5842005e2c3b0249268f5a31632801c6e714c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Choosing Sides[/b][/h2][p]When equipping:[/p][olist][*][p]Pick [b]Front[/b] (safe) or [b]Back[/b] (powerful + backlash)[/p][/*][*][p][i]The unchosen effect is lost forever.[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/e456dc2e74afaf0a3b87140bbe9d6d8cb9ac39e1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Managing Qi Backlash[/b][/h2][p]Choosing [b]Back Face[/b] forces you to draft [b]1 of 3 random debuffs[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/ab1a498f9e529cc1eef6980750195ab17a8d5d50.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Relic Finalization[/b][/h2][p]Your choice + debuff become [b]permanent[/b] for that relic.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/760c376d7a5216ed0ba14020d12b2c4195a94abe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Faction Example: Division[/b][/h2][p][i](Art: 4 Division relics shown)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]First 3 Relics[/b]: Huge stat boosts, but...
[b]Backlash[/b]: "Clones itself each round"—filling Armory slots![/p][/*][*][p][b]Final Relic \[Division Stone][/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Boosts all Division relics[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Eats" clones[/b] to empower itself + clears their debuffs![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/adfa380ab55a00b527702534268e09fd89fd6c7d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Roguelike Strategy[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Race against time[/b]: Complete your build before debuffs cripple you![/p][/*][*][p][b]Adapt[/b]: Balance faction skills vs. store RNG each round.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Combat Impact[/b][/h2][p]All Front/Back effects apply [b]permanently[/b] once activated. But—new relics can shift your build mid-run![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/24f7dab64fc94aa2106423990e46983720858856.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Why We Love This[/b][/h2][p]Dual-Faced Relics add [b]high-risk gambles[/b] and [b]backlash management[/b] to core strategy. Will you embrace corruption for power?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fate System Gameplay New Concept: Matrix Configuration
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow heroes![/p][p]Following up from our previous discussion, we are excited to share the latest concept for the Fate system gameplay: Matrix Configuration (which has a Tetris-like experience). We'll refer to it as Fate: Matrix moving forward.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/6c8e7aa9aa48d9b3364575030602702807692926.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Playtest Description[/b][/h2][p]To emphasize again, this Steam beta version is still a work in progress due to time constraints, so not all features are included. Initially, we planned to have Store, Combat, and Fate segments, but unfortunately, the Fate gameplay didn’t make it into this version. However, don’t worry! The current gameplay flow works fine![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/6d55b7166659b5ac4ca32606f7757523c9b1f385.png"][/img][/p][p]Earlier, we discussed a Fate: Dice gameplay configuration. If you're interested, you can check it out here:
[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3378130/announcements/detail/507331412174575237"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Now, let's dive deeper into the design of Fate: Matrix.[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Relic Grid[/b][/h2][p][b]After adding Fate, the relic grid will become a neat 6x5 board. All the cells are empty, and you can place relics wherever you want.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/703d51e8af164ae4dd200fcb36539d74737504bc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Relic Shapes and Colors[/b][/h2][p][b]Each relic has a fixed shape that occupies specific cells and a color that fills the corresponding space.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/a6c89fd8f038caf0ad8deded9066a59ac845b293.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Placing Relics[/b][/h2][p][b]Previously, relics would be activated when placed in the weapon roster, but now they need to be placed on this grid to be effective. The goal is to rotate and place relics, which you buy from the store, into the grid to fill it as much as possible.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/c67d61c78a84e23d80c072f0302b88ea834c3657.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Row/Column Buffs[/b][/h2][p][b]Each row and column on the grid has a unique buff. For example, a particular column might grant a 5% increase in external damage.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/305441f35483fae51e4b7fc8fca9abca2f847894.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Activating Buffs[/b][/h2][p]When you fill an entire row or column with relics, you can activate that row’s or column’s cell buff. For example, if a row is completely filled with relics, it activates a 5% life steal buff. The multicolored gem represents a filled row/column with relics of different colors. What’s the use of this gem? We’ll explain shortly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/7f908b7cff07a7efdbca0822b99d486810353bbc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gem Buffs[/b][/h2][p][b]If you place relics strategically, and a row/column you fill has relics of the same color (it can be multicolored, but with slightly reduced effectiveness), you’ll activate an additional Gem Buff. For example, in the image below, this column is entirely filled with purple relics, which activates the Purple Gem Buff: 5% increase in all damage.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/716040f57fcdfc2f28fea6044173a3745e57b1b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Roguelike Strategy[/b][/h2][p][b]The ideal scenario is, of course, to fill the entire grid with relics, and each row/column is of a single color! However, given the random nature of the shop's inventory, the different shapes and colors of relics, and the need to align with faction skills, achieving this perfectly is difficult. Players will need to adjust their layout and strategy flexibly each round based on the situation.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Combat Effects[/b][/h2][p][b]After completing the Fate phase, all activated buffs will carry over to the next battle. However, this is not fixed – each time you visit the Store, you can readjust the grid and activate different buffs to align with your current playstyle.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/24f7dab64fc94aa2106423990e46983720858856.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2][p][b]The Fate: Matrix gameplay adds a layer of strategy to relics, where you need to consider not only their effects but also their shape, color, and placement on the grid. Maximizing the grid’s potential and activating various buffs becomes the core strategy for roguelike gameplay.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Currently, the Fate system is still in the experimental phase, and this is just one prototype of the gameplay. In the future, we’ll continue to introduce new roguelike gameplay ideas like this – whatever makes the game more fun! Feel free to share any thoughts with us; let’s build this game together![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Fighting Rogue V0.1 First Playtest Launches Today!
notes.content:
[p][b]Heroes ，your wait is over![/b][/p][p][i]Fighting Rogue [/i][b]V0.1[/b] launches today on Steam for its inaugural playtest.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Core Gameplay[/b][/h3][p]A [b]wuxia roguelike[/b] blending:
🔹 [b]Strategic Buildcrafting[/b] (Relics/Skill Synergy)
🔹 [b]Auto-Battler Combat[/b] (Focus: Tactics over Twitch)
🔹 [b]Async PvP[/b] (Test your builds globally)[/p][p][i]Enhanced by deep faction identities, character-driven narratives, and visceral martial arts flair—all packed into a tight indie experience.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This marks our [b]first public test[/b], and we approach it with both excitement and anxiety. While the current build offers playable [b]\[Shop Phase][/b] and [b]\[Combat Phase][/b]—delivering core strategic buildcrafting fun—the strategy-deepening [b]\[Fate Dice system][/b] remains in active prototyping.[/p][p]To date, we’ve designed [b]multiple promising prototypes[/b] for this system. We’ll gradually reveal these concepts via announcements, inviting you to [b]collaborate with us[/b] in refining the most engaging and fun iteration.[/p][p]Our first prototype—the [b]dice-based design[/b]—was previewed across channels earlier this week. Revisit the details below if you’re curious![/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/6d55b7166659b5ac4ca32606f7757523c9b1f385.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Key Notes[/b][/h3][p]⚠️ [b]Wiped Test[/b]: Progress resets due to future mechanic changes.
⚠️ [b]Localization[/b]: Only Simplified Chinese is fully supported currently.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Current Test Scope[/b][/h3][p][b]Two Launch Heroes[/b] (Female Protagonists):[/p][list][*][p][b]Su Lianxiang[/b] (Cold Plum Pavilion | Stealth Assassin)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bai Xinyan[/b] (Swift Heroine | Duelist Specialist)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/183dd73a499b6504515050869735b8016d17dcba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]100+ Relics & Manuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Explore divergent build paths for both characters[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/f7d3d7946a8f686fa1d43555c0eeeceaab78584d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat Philosophy[/b][/h3][p]Though automated, battles deliver [b]bone-crunching impact[/b] with:[/p][list][*][p]Motion-captured wuxia animations[/p][/*][*][p]Character-unique fighting styles reflecting backstories[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic [b]Title Progression[/b] (e.g., [i]"Novice"[/i] → [i]"Arena Dominator"[/i])[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/ac955535c6aebd96bc5f3a68b887251ebdd0c754.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/a776d5dc1af5bc99bd3efbb8030cc6ec08b39c0b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]"This tournament is but the first step on your wuxia journey. We apologize for any shortcomings—greater adventures await!"[/i]—The [i]Fighting Rogue [/i]Team[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]We’re iterating on [b]Fate Dice[/b] and other roguelike systems—your feedback will shape them![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fate Dice System Sneak Peek[/b][/h3][p][i](Design concept—subject to change)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/4e517284c04c7972a59915eeb53182b9a6df4df9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Every relic bought in the [b]Shop[/b] gains a random [b]combat skill[/b] (Fate Trait) + [b]activation requirement[/b] (dice combination needed).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/59d23000038ebc3fedb1888cb04870e3a09a3d4c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]View all gear requirements from your [b]Armory[/b], categorized as:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/5e529a6e12f0747ff96e0d914829163c0828a5e5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Specific dice faces (e.g., 1-3 pips)[/p][/*][*][p]Dice sum within a range[/p][/*][*][p]Exact dice sum[/p][/*][*][p]Other conditions...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Roll [b]5 dice[/b]—activate [i]all[/i] gear whose conditions match the results! [i](No dice consumed!)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/1da454c8b60a95dd999b2a1aa999df690b6b2686.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Use [b]"Trick Cards"[/b] (earned every 3 rounds) to manipulate dice:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/a9ba81aa8f3f226c4a570e5b7e2032d22179a7f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Drag dice onto cards for effects (e.g., reroll specific dice)[/p][/*][*][p]Limited uses per round[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/e91f20a47ea1570f2bda839316d004fa886104e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Activated skills apply to your [b]next battle only[/b]—re-roll each fight![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/3f8edc151361f021e44ef59310c92dc9233f4a59.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Why we love it:[/b] Forces strategic trade-offs, deepens build diversity![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Help Us Shape This![/b][/h3][p]Fate Dice is experimental—we might tweak or replace it based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Design Story: Su Lianxiang
notes.content: [p]In the previous post, we introduced the character design of Su Lianxiang, the top assassin of the Hanmei Pavilion. Cold, ruthless, and deadly like a serpent, she embodies a lethal elegance. notes.title: Jianghu Bulletin: Fighting Rogue Arrives!
notes.content:
Greetings, Jianghu Heroes!

Fighting Rogue—our passion-fueled wuxia roguelike tactics game—is coming soon! Step into the boots of a rising sect disciple, battle legendary rivals in the heart-pounding [Martial Arts Tournament], and carve your saga in the annals of Jianghu!

Core Gameplay:
A 1v1 auto-battler with manual skill curation. Each round, strategically purchase [Martial Manuals] and [Jianghu Relics] to empower your hero against increasingly fierce arena opponents.

Demo Update:
Arriving this June! (Date TBA)
We’re excited—and nervous!—to debut our two signature heroines in this build. Your feedback will shape their journey!

Why We Made This:
We’re lifelong wuxia fans who bonded over classics. This game is our love letter to the genre.
